summary: The table presents a financial performance summary comparing key financial metrics for the periods ending March 31, 2025, and March 31, 2024, along with their growth percentages. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, operating profit, and net profit before and after minority interest. The table also details earnings per share (EPS) and dividend per share. Notable insights include a revenue growth of 6.1% and a gross profit increase of 7.3%. Operating expenses saw a rise, with selling and marketing expenses increasing by 8.8%. The operating margin remained relatively stable, while net profit after minority interest showed a modest growth of 1.8%. The dividend per share experienced a significant increase of 13.2%.
